chunks: Hammad narrated from al-Halabi from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: A man acknowledges a debt owed by him to an heir. He said: "It is permissible if he is solvent."

key_terms.لِوَارِثٍ: in favor of an heir entitled to inheritance
key_terms.يَجُوزُ: it is permissible or legally valid

ai.seo_question: Is a man's acknowledgment of debt to one of his heirs legally valid in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a person acknowledging a debt in favor of one of his heirs. The acknowledgment is valid when the person is financially solvent, indicating that such an admission is accepted when it does not appear to be a harmful manipulation of inheritance rights.
